name: hud_ui_element_draw_base
description: HudUiElement::DrawBase blits the element's attached image at its x/y position using clipRect and clip flags 0, and does nothing when no image is attached.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the coherent HudUiElement common source cluster.

The native smoke verifies the null-image no-op path and the blit path's image pointer, x/y coordinates, zero clip flags, and source rectangle values.
